subject: Request: temporary bridge credits while PO clears
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha@neotech.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Credit reinstatement request — NeoTech POC stalled

Hi Marcus,

Hope you’re well. We completed a short POC with Redwood last month but procurement hit an internal freeze and our sandbox credits expired before we could finalize the commercial paperwork. The engineers still need to finish a couple of integration tests to validate the latency/throughput numbers for our SRE team.

Can you do a one‑time bridge so we can finish the evaluation? We’re asking for 10,000 tokens (rough estimate based on the attached usage) or an equivalent $1,200 of sandbox credit for ~2 weeks. We will have a PO signed by 2028‑04‑25 and are prepared to sign the amendment (attach) to commit to a paid pilot thereafter.

Attached: trial-usage-report.csv (sample usage, last 30 days).

Appreciate any help — this POC is timing‑sensitive for our Q2 roadmap.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Head of ML Ops
NeoTech AI
Samantha.liu@neotech.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@neotech.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-21T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Credit reinstatement request — NeoTech POC stalled

Hi Samantha — thanks for the context and the usage CSV. I’m looping in Lauren (your AE) and Jonas (team lead) to evaluate a one‑off exception. Two quick clarifying questions:

- Can you confirm which project/environment the usage maps to (env id or repo)?
- Is procurement able to provide a formal PO by 2028‑04‑25 as mentioned? If the PO slips we’ll need to tie any bridge to stronger billing conditions.

Internally I’ll request a provisional bridge and propose conditional credits that expire if the PO or signed amendment isn’t received in 10 days. Will update shortly.

—Marcus
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-21T11:10:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Credit reinstatement request — NeoTech POC stalled

Forwarding — NeoTech asking for a temporary bridge while procurement issues clear. Attached usage file and proposed amendment (draft). Summary: external requests ~10k tokens (~$1.2k) for 14 days. They commit to PO by 2028‑04‑25.

Recommendation: approve provisional bridge but gate release on either (A) signed amendment / DocuSign or (B) confirmed PO. If we can’t get either, suggest a smaller immediate top‑up (2k) to unblock devs and then release remainder on paperwork.

Please reply with approval + amount. I’ll capture in HubSpot and notify customer.

—Marcus

On 2028‑04‑21 09:12, Samantha Liu wrote:
> Hi Marcus,
> 
> Hope you’re well. We completed a short POC...

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-21T15:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Credit reinstatement request — NeoTech POC stalled

Thanks for the heads up. Given NeoTech’s traction and clear intent to proceed, I approve a one‑time provisional allocation of 7,000 tokens (approx $840) to bridge the engineering gate. Conditions:

1) Credits expire in 10 days if no PO or signed amendment is received.
2) Customer must acknowledge the repayment/charge terms in email (I’ll accept a shot‑gun confirmation from their procurement).

Lauren — can you negotiate the amendment so it includes a short invoice/PO window and a clause that the remaining credits (if any) will be charged if they don’t execute? I’ll log this under deal ND-2028-3312: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ND-2028-3312

-Jonas
Head of Sales, Americas
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-22T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Credit reinstatement request — NeoTech POC stalled

Finance note: we can provision a provisional 2,000‑token top‑up immediately as a courtesy without a signed PO; remaining 5,000 tokens will be contingent on receiving either a valid PO or a countersigned amendment before 2028‑04‑30. If NeoTech misses the date we will reclaim unused credits. Please ensure the AE collects an explicit written acknowledgement from procurement that a PO is en route.

Attachment: draft‑amendment.docx (requested contract language).

—Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai

From: Samantha Liu <samantha@neotech.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-23T17:38:00Z
Subject: Re: Credit reinstatement request — NeoTech POC stalled

Marcus / Lauren — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the provisional plan. Procurement confirms they will issue the PO by COB 2028‑04‑25; I’ve attached a brief internal note (procurement will send official doc). We accept the 10‑day conditional window.

Can you provision the 2,000 tokens now to unblock our team? Once the PO lands we’ll finalize the amendment.

Thanks — we appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Samantha Liu
Head of ML Ops
NeoTech AI
